reason: A dsh plugin that runs an independent reviewer model per session, observes the primary transcript, and injects bounded advisory notes without taking primary-agent actions.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 会话配置独立的审查模型，观察主模型对话并以分级建议形式注入反馈。
summaries.en: Configures an independent reviewer model for dsh sessions to observe the primary transcript and inject severity-ranked advisory feedback.

capabilities: Reads the primary session transcript for review
Calls a separately configured reviewer model
Injects severity-ranked advisory messages into the session
Provides session-scoped advisor controls and persistent configuration
